name: 🎃 RIVALS
desc:
🎃 BOO! UPDATE 6 IS HERE - Spooky Event, Haunted Chest, Spooky Skin Case, New Map, New Gamemode, & MORE! Check out the patch notes in-game to see all the details! 🎉

Welcome to RIVALS, the most intense first person shooter game on Roblox! Challenge other players in 1v1 to 5v5 FPS duels where the first to 5 wins.

🔫 Challenge someone by stepping on a duel pad!
🔑 Earn keys to unlock new weapons & skins!
📜 Complete contracts to unlock exclusive rewards!
🏆 Show off your win streak and climb the leaderboards! 

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX, & PlayStation 5
💜 Like and Join the group for an exclusive reward!

⚠️ WARNING: Exploiters will be permanently banned with no second chances, our anti-cheat & moderators will catch you. Farming for wins using friends/alts is also not allowed!
